about.title: About Daily Tale
about.metaDescription: Learn about Daily Tale, our global multilingual folktale library, educational mission, and founder Dr. S. Edward Packiaraj.
about.summary: Daily Tale – Moral Stories & Interesting Folktales is a multilingual digital storytelling sanctuary dedicated to nourishing character, imagination, and empathy through timeless folktales, fables, and heritage wisdom from world cultures.

sections.heading: Multilingual Folklore Treasury
sections.content: We bring together over 2,448 curated stories across 8 languages: English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Marathi, and Chinese (Simplified). Our collections span Akbar–Birbal, Tenali Rama, Panchatantra, Aesop's Fables, Jataka Tales, Hans Christian Andersen, the Brothers Grimm, Arabian Nights, and cultural folklore from across Asia, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.

sections.heading: Audio & Adaptive Reading Toolbar
sections.content: Our platform offers browser-native audio narration with text-to-speech, sentence-by-sentence reading assistance, and adjustable playback speed (0.8x to 1.5x), along with specialized typography controls including the OpenDyslexic typeface, custom font sizing, fluid line-height adjustment, and night/sepia reading themes.

sections.heading: Structured Pedagogical Depth
sections.content: To support parents, educators, and language learners, every story includes structured Bloom's Taxonomy reflection prompts (spanning Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create levels), curated in-text vocabulary glossaries with exact definitions, and interactive comprehension quizzes that cultivate critical thinking and family dialogue.

sections.heading: Classroom & Community-Ready Resources
sections.content: We provide ready-to-share educational tools, including exportable 'Moral of the Day' cards, reading milestone certificates, printable story summaries, and seamless one-click sharing via WhatsApp, Telegram, and email for home, community, and classroom reflection.

sections.heading: Lightweight PWA & 100% Privacy Commitment
sections.content: Built with lightweight Progressive Web App (PWA) technology and browser-native audio capabilities, Daily Tale is designed for accessibility, instant offline reading, and minimal server dependency. Our commitment is absolute: 100% free, 100% ad-free, zero tracking, and zero user registration.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.content: To make timeless moral wisdom, character values, and world folklore freely accessible, understandable, and inspiring every day, supporting families, educators, and language learners in growing together in empathy and global literacy.

sections.heading: About Me — Edward Packiaraj
sections.content: S. Edward Packiaraj (M.Com., M.Phil., B.Ed., BLIS., PGDBA., PGDCA.) is Consultant – Educational Media Technologies, Rosary e-Solutions, Trichy. With 22 years of experience in radio broadcasting (All India Radio, IGNOU FM), 17+ years in Educational Technology / e-Content Development, 250+ invited lectures delivered, creator of 2000+ educational video lessons and 65+ Interactive Multimedia Self-Learning Packages, Board of Studies member at Centre for Distance Education, Bharathidasan University, Trichy, and Educational Technology Cell member at Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University, Chennai. Built on the belief that everyone deserves access to learning without paywalls: 'Learn More! Teach More!'

founder.aboutFounder:
With over two decades of experience in educational technology, scriptwriting, instructional audio production, and digital curriculum development, Edward Packiaraj is dedicated to making quality educational resources and digital tools accessible to learners from diverse backgrounds.

His professional journey includes broadcasting and educational media contributions with All India Radio (AIR), IGNOU GyanVani FM, and the Department of Educational Technology at Bharathidasan University. Drawing on this multidisciplinary experience, he combines communication, instructional design, and emerging technologies to create meaningful and engaging learning experiences.

As an independent creator and developer, he also designs and develops free digital tools and web-based utilities that help people learn, create, and work more effectively. His focus is on building practical, accessible solutions that reduce barriers to technology and make useful digital resources available to everyone.

A strong advocate of Open Educational Resources (OER), Edward is passionate about harnessing Artificial Intelligence, e-learning, and digital content development to transform education and expand access to knowledge.

His vision is to build inclusive, learner-centred digital learning environments and freely accessible tools—without paywalls, subscription fees, or intrusive data tracking.

Through his work, he continues to champion the idea that quality education and useful technology should be open, accessible, engaging, and available to all.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.metaDescription: Educational and literary disclaimer regarding retold folklore, cultural parables, and linguistic translations.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of the Platform
sections.content: All stories, quizzes, moral summaries, and learning activities provided on Daily Tale are intended strictly for educational, ethical, and literary enjoyment. They do not constitute professional, legal, medical, or psychological advice.

sections.heading: 2. Folklore Retelling & Cultural Parables
sections.content: Stories originating from ancient lore, fables, and folk traditions are presented purely as cultural heritage and literary parables. To maintain a peaceful, universal, and non-sectarian environment accessible to families and readers of all faiths and beliefs worldwide, narratives focus on universal human values such as honesty, courage, empathy, and wisdom.

sections.heading: 3. Translations
sections.content: Multilingual translations are prepared with the assistance of advanced language models and reviewed by human linguists. While we strive for absolute linguistic elegance, nuances may occasionally differ. Readers are encouraged to reach out to suggest phrase refinements.

sections.heading: 4. Reader Submissions
sections.content: Original tales submitted by community members and published after moderation reflect the creative imagination of their respective authors, not the official stance of Daily Tale.

sections.heading: 5. Family & Educator Guidance
sections.content: While our editorial board strictly enforces family-safe ratings and community standards, parents and educators remain the ultimate guides of suitability for individual young readers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Reader Data Protection
privacy.h1: Reader Privacy, COPPA Compliance, and Edge Telemetry
privacy.metaDescription: Daily Tale's privacy policy: Zero cookies, no advertising, anonymous edge hit counter, COPPA reader protection, and commitment to student privacy.

sections.heading: 1. Absolute Commitment to Reader Privacy
sections.content: Daily Tale is designed from the ground up as a safe, distraction-free educational reading platform. We do not require account registration, do not collect personal names or phone numbers, and never sell or monetize reader data. We do not use third-party marketing cookies, behavioural trackers, or targeted advertising networks.

sections.heading: 2. Edge Telemetry and Anonymous Hit Counter
sections.content: Daily Tale is hosted on Cloudflare's global edge network (Cloudflare Pages and Workers). To display an aggregate, anonymous live reader count (Hit Counter), our edge worker registers an anonymous visit tally stored securely in Cloudflare KV. This process operates without persistent tracking cookies, without fingerprinting, and without logging personal IP addresses. The counter measures aggregate platform traffic strictly for server health and educational impact monitoring.

sections.heading: 3. Child Protection & Student Privacy (COPPA & Global Standards)
sections.content: Daily Tale is dedicated to the safety of young readers and fully complies with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and international student privacy norms. No personal identifiers are ever solicited from children. Local settings (such as text-to-speech voice preference, dark mode, font size, and bedtime reading mode) are saved solely inside the user's local browser storage (localStorage) and never transmitted to our servers.

sections.heading: 4. Publisher & Editorial Contact
sections.content: Daily Tale is published as an Open Educational Resource initiative curated by Dr. S. Edward Packiaraj, Consultant in Educational Media Technologies, Rosary e-Solutions, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India. For privacy inquiries or editorial questions, please contact edpackiaraj@gmail.com or editor@dailystory.pages.dev.

sections.heading: 2. Permitted Educational & Personal Use
sections.content: You are warmly welcome to read, listen to, and share these stories at home and in school classrooms. Teachers and educators are explicitly permitted to project stories and print worksheets for non-commercial educational use.

sections.heading: 3. Restrictions: No Scraping or Bulk Copying
sections.content: You may not systematically scrape, harvest, reproduce in bulk, mirror, or ingest our stories, translations, audio, or quizzes into automated commercial databases or competing services without prior written permission.

sections.content: When you submit an original story, you retain full copyright ownership of your work. By submitting, you grant Daily Tale a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to format, translate, and publish the story on our platform with credit to your pen name.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: Daily Tale is provided on an 'as-is' and 'as-available' basis without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for incidental or consequential damages resulting from platform use.

copyright.title: Copyright & Intellectual Property Policy
copyright.h1: Intellectual Property, Public Domain, and Fair Use Policy
copyright.metaDescription: Daily Tale's comprehensive copyright policy covering public domain folklore, historical fair use for science and leader debates, and creative commons educational licenses.

sections.heading: 1. Public Domain Folklore and Classical Heritage
sections.content: Traditional folktales, fables, and ancient literatures featured on Daily Tale—including Aesop's Fables, Panchatantra, Jataka Tales, Vikram & Vetal, Tenali Rama, Birbal anecdotes, Grimm's Fairy Tales, Hans Christian Andersen tales, and Arabian Nights—belong to the worldwide public domain. These foundational world stories are freely retold and adapted for modern educational and cultural literacy.

sections.heading: 2. Historical Science Chronicles & Leader Debates (Fair Use & OER)
sections.content: The chronicles in '200 Authentic Science Stories' and 'Witty Debates & Historic Repartees' are educational historical non-fiction accounts based on documented public records, speeches, biographies, and academic archives. These retellings are authored under academic Fair Use principles and Open Educational Resources (OER) frameworks, designed to cultivate scientific curiosity, moral reasoning, and parliamentary eloquence among students and lifelong learners worldwide.

sections.heading: 3. Pedagogical Content and Creative Commons Licensing
sections.content: The original literary adaptations, modern translations across 9 languages, curated pedagogical quizzes, vocabulary glossaries, classroom discussion prompts, editorial essays, and responsive UI components are the creative works of Daily Tale and its Chief Editor, Dr. S. Edward Packiaraj. Educational non-commercial reuse is encouraged under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).

sections.heading: 4. Notice and Takedown Procedure (DMCA & Global Standards)
sections.content: Daily Tale adheres strictly to copyright laws and respects intellectual property rights. If you are a copyright holder or designated agent and believe that any text, image, or audio on our site infringes your rights, please send a formal notice to our editorial office at edpackiaraj@gmail.com or editor@dailystory.pages.dev. Please include: (a) Identification of the work claimed to be infringed; (b) The specific URL on Daily Tale; (c) Your full contact details; and (d) A statement of good faith belief. Legitimate inquiries receive an immediate acknowledgement within 24 hours and resolution within 48 hours.
